full_prompt_en: A square decorative illustration shows a gray-haired man writing at a desk inside an ornate ochre frame. The patterned border runs along all four edges, made of small geometric panels, curling motifs, and corner breaks that open into the central scene. In the foreground at right, the older man sits close to the viewer in a deep blue suit with a white collar and dark tie. His curly gray hair, heavy mustache, and pointed white beard frame a thoughtful face lowered toward a broad pale sheet. One hand rests against his chin, while the other holds a slim pencil over the paper; the small marks on the sheet are too fine to read. Behind him at left, a woman in a long, pale dress stands sideways near a work surface. She has dark hair arranged in an updo and looks downward toward her hands. A large flat ochre disk hangs or stands just beyond her, balancing the man's head and echoing the golden border. Shelves, vessels, and boxlike objects fill the blue-green interior behind the figures in overlapping, carefully outlined layers. At the upper right inside the border, a tan ornamental profile is worked into the frame. Fine ink contours and textured color fields distinguish hair, cloth, wood, and decorative pattern, while the palette remains controlled: dusty blue, cream, tan, ochre, and warm flesh tones. Light comes gently from the left, brightening the paper, pale dress, and man's forehead without casting severe shadows. The overall composition is intimate yet highly designed, placing a focused human activity inside a dense geometric and ornamental surround.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰性插画呈现一名灰发男子在华丽赭色边框内的书桌前书写。花纹边框沿四边延展，由小几何面板、卷曲纹样和向中央场景打开的角部缺口组成。右侧前景，年长男子身穿深蓝西服、白色衣领和深色领带，贴近观者而坐。卷曲灰发、浓密胡子与尖白须围住一张沉思的面孔，他低头望着一大张浅色纸。一只手抵在下巴，另一只手握细铅笔悬于纸面；纸上的细小笔迹无法辨读。他身后左侧，一位身穿浅色长裙的女子侧身站在工作台旁。深发盘起，她低头看向双手。她外侧有一只平坦的大赭色圆盘，与男子头部平衡，也呼应金色边框。搁架、容器与盒状物以交叠且细致勾线的层次填满人物背后的蓝绿色室内。边框内右上角，一道土黄色装饰侧影融入花框。细墨线轮廓与有肌理的色域区分头发、衣布、木料和装饰纹样，色板则控制在灰蓝、奶油、土黄、赭色与暖肤色中。光从左侧轻柔照来，提亮纸面、浅色长裙与男子额头，而没有投下严厉阴影。整体构图亲密却高度设计化，把专注的人类活动放入密集的几何与装饰围框之中。
style_prompt_en: The decorative illustration combines carefully modeled forms with flat, intricately patterned framing. Fine contour lines define local detail, while muted blocks of blue, cream, ochre, and warm brown connect the center to the border. Dense geometry and curling motifs organize the edges, leaving an irregular opening for a quieter, more naturalistic focal field. Surfaces have a lightly printed, grainy quality; small marks and delicate shading create volume without losing the graphic unity of the page. Warm circular and rectangular accents counter cooler broad areas, producing rhythm rather than strong depth. Light is soft and distributed, with pale surfaces gently lifted from darker surroundings. Spatial layers overlap closely, and the frame behaves as part of the composition rather than a separate afterthought. The overall effect is cultivated and tactile, balancing intimate realism with ornamental discipline.
style_prompt_zh: 这种装饰性插画把细致塑形的形体与平坦、纹样繁密的围框结合。细轮廓线界定局部细节，低调蓝、奶油、赭与暖棕色块则把中央和边缘串联。密集几何与卷曲纹样组织四边，为较安静、较自然主义的焦点场域留下不规则开口。表面带轻微印刷颗粒质感；细小笔迹与精巧阴影制造体积，又不失整页图形统一。暖色圆形和矩形重音对抗较冷的宽阔区域，产生节奏而非强烈纵深。光柔和分布，浅色表面从周围深暗中轻轻浮起。空间层次紧密重叠，围框是构图的一部分，而非事后添加的边饰。整体效果精致且可触，让亲密写实与装饰纪律取得平衡。
theme_en: A gray-haired man writing at a desk inside an ornate decorative frame
theme_zh: 灰发男子在华饰边框内的书桌前书写
name: Koloman Moser
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
